mutations.label: backlog-record-sweep: a bare citation is not a claim, or the sweep drowns in noise
mutations.only: ^(?:a bare citation is not a claim, and a heading or a proposal phrase is)$

mutations.label: backlog-record-sweep: one live record keeps a section live
mutations.only: ^(?:a section is flagged only when EVERY record it claims has shipped)$

mutations.label: backlog-record-sweep: an unresolvable record is could-not-look, never a shipped one
mutations.from: if (done === 0 && open.length === 0) return { id, state: 'unknown', why: 'no tasks to judge', status }
mutations.to: if (false) return { id, state: 'unknown', why: 'no tasks to judge', status }
mutations.only: ^(?:a record it cannot resolve is COULD NOT LOOK, never a finding about the section)$

mutations.label: backlog sweep: an archived pointer reads as the archived section's text
mutations.from: const pointer = lines[i].startsWith('## ') && lines[i + 1] === '' ? ARCHIVED.exec(lines[i + 2] ?? '') : null
mutations.only: ^readBacklog puts every archived body back, and a pointer to a missing section is an error$

mutations.label: backlog sweep: a pointer to a section the archive does not hold is an error, not a skip
mutations.from: if (!block) throw new Error(`docs/BACKLOG.md points ${lines[i]} at backlog-archive/${pointer[1]}, which has no such section`)
mutations.only: ^readBacklog puts every archived body back, and a pointer to a missing section is an error$
